title: Edit the /account Portion of Member Dashboard URL
text:
## Edit the /account Portion of Member Dashboard URL
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000089676
The member dashboard URL by default is linked to:
www.yourdomain.com /account/home
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12114088343/original/gKl2o4cTggarXY4D5x_VmGEu2uFZYSOTBQ.png?1662473375 | alt: ]
However depending on the site verbiage or language this may need to be changed. There is an advanced setting that will allow the / account portion of the URL to be updated:
Member Dashboard URL System Variable: default_account_url
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647534/original/rWsWOK-0zEmRs_gA5qry8fLoLJ61PSwZww.png?1753161796 | alt: ]
Add the text into the field, save the changes and the URL is immediately updated without needing to reset anything:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647551/original/3x0KMEd0CbP7o94qMpr0k-uB2Q0rQzIyZQ.png?1753161844 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12114088998/original/80p3RhrpdurOa9MfE_J5OYHHz802BGqYcQ.png?1662473879 | alt: ]
